Technical SEO.title: Google Search Spam Updates Use AI To Find AI Spam & More
Technical SEO.summary: Google revealed at its Search Central Live Deep Dive Europe 2026 event that it has increased the frequency of spam updates in 2026 due to a surge in new content volume, and is now using AI to detect and catch more spam.

Technical SEO.title: Google Search Data On Crawling, Indexing & Serving Timelines
Technical SEO.summary: Gary Illyes from Google presented new data at a recent event showing average and slowest timeframes for each stage of the crawling, indexing, and serving pipeline, broken down by process.

Technical SEO.title: Google Explains Couldnt Fetch Sitemap Errors
Technical SEO.summary: Google has clarified that a 'couldn't fetch' sitemap error in Search Console may not actually indicate that Googlebot is unable to retrieve the sitemap, signaling the error message can be misleading.

Technical SEO.title: What To Expect From Googles Next Search Ranking Update
Technical SEO.summary: An analysis of Google's recent changes offers clues about what major shifts to anticipate from the next core algorithm update.

Technical SEO.title: Dark Mode Coming To Google Search Console
Technical SEO.summary: A Senior Software Engineer at Google announced dark mode support is coming to Google Search Console, revealed at the Google Search Central Live Deep Dive Europe 2026 event in Barcelona.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Googles Mueller Says AI Crawlers Access Sitemaps & RSS In His Logs
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: John Mueller confirmed that AI training crawlers are showing up in his server logs accessing sitemaps and RSS feeds, and suggests using default sitemap names or RSS feeds to improve discoverability since most AI crawlers do not offer sitemap submission tools.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Is Fighting SERP Tracking. AI Agents May Make It Worse
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google is actively working to counter SERP rank tracking, and the proliferation of AI agents is expected to push the company toward even stricter restrictions on rank-tracking activity.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI Cites Your Brand: How to Choose Your Next Move
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece outlines a decision framework for addressing AI visibility gaps, covering options such as correcting inaccurate information, earning more brand mentions, creating new content, and auditing bot access.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: OpenAI To Watermark ChatGPT Text In The EU, Opens API Opt-In
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: OpenAI will apply an invisible watermark to ChatGPT and Codex-generated text for EU users, though its own testing indicates editing the text can weaken the watermark's integrity.

AI Search / GEO.title: OpenAI To Test Visual ChatGPT Ad Format During AI Image Generation
AI Search / GEO.summary: OpenAI announced it will test a new visual ad format inside ChatGPT later this month in the US, surfacing ads during the image generation process with an initial group of advertisers.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Overviews jump from 26% to 80% of branded queries
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google AI Overviews are now appearing on the large majority of branded search queries, representing a major increase in AI Overview coverage that has direct implications for brand visibility and organic CTR.

AI Search / GEO.title: GSC AI Position Reporting Will Evolve, Mueller Says
AI Search / GEO.summary: John Mueller has indicated that how Google Search Console reports on AI-related search positions will change over time, signaling that current GSC data for AI surfaces should be interpreted with caution.

AI Search / GEO.title: October 2026 Google Webmaster Report: Spam Update, Gemini 3.8, AI Contribution & Monopoly Rulings
AI Search / GEO.summary: A monthly roundup covering key October 2026 developments including a Google spam update, the Gemini 3.8 model, AI contribution features, and ongoing monopoly ruling implications for search.
